design_note: DESIGN-ONLY. This artifact designs (does NOT execute) the future controlled, separately-gated lifecycle that could earn ONE genuine REAL_IMAGE_PROOF against ONE real candidate image, and designs the closure of L-F2R3-NEARCOPY / L-F2R3-BYPASS-STATIC / L-F2R3-REFLECTIVE. Real-image proof cannot be produced yet: design.hermes_fw08_real_image_proof_v1.production_real_image_source_available() is False, so assemble_proof(candidate_mode='REAL_CANDIDATE') always fails closed with ('F2R3-REAL-PROOF-REQUIRES-REAL-IMAGE-AND-AUTHORITY','RIP-REAL-SOURCE-UNAVAILABLE'). Nothing here builds, inspects, signs, publishes, deploys, or activates anything.

operator_authority_matrix.may: sequence the lifecycle, authorise each gate, authorise publication and deployment decisions, name the canonical source and candidate
operator_authority_matrix.may_not: perform controlled execution, inspect images, sign, deploy, or audit; may not self-approve a mutation it also performs

operator_authority_matrix.may: perform controlled execution ONLY under Chief Architect authorisation (configuration, validation invocation, cleanup/quarantine)
operator_authority_matrix.may_not: authorise itself, approve its own mutations, perform the independent audit, or set proof classification

operator_authority_matrix.may: perform independent, READ-ONLY audit and issue the audit blueprint/verdict
operator_authority_matrix.may_not: execute, mutate any evidence, build any evidence it then audits, or approve its own work (no self-audit)

operator_authority_matrix.may: produce build evidence only (candidate-image build, immutable digest capture)
operator_authority_matrix.may_not: perform OCI inspection, verify proof, or approve/audit its own build evidence

operator_authority_matrix.may: produce inspection evidence only (independent OCI inspection, SBOM, vulnerability scan) by digest
operator_authority_matrix.may_not: consume the build payload as truth, build the image, verify proof, or approve/audit its own inspection evidence

build_oci_distinctness_assertion.assertion: build producer and OCI producer MUST be distinct across all six dimensions; identity is keyed on executable_digest + authority_reference + runner_identity, NOT on tool/producer names

real_authority_contract.resolver: ProductionAuthorityResolver via require_resolver (F2-R1 §9); no /etc or filesystem fallback
real_authority_contract.verifier: verifier-only application interface (module verifier), no signing capability exposed to callers
real_authority_contract.signing_or_attestation: external signing/attestation boundary; non-exportable key or equivalent; application holds a verifier-only interface (reference only)
real_authority_contract.approval_authority: external approval authority; distinct/authorised/non-self/unexpired quorum >= threshold (F2-R1 §14 evaluate_approvals)
real_authority_contract.revocation_source: external RevocationSet (F2-R1 §15); authority root / manifest / producer / approver revocable, effective-time gated
real_authority_contract.expiry: authority artefacts carry future expiry; expired -> fail-closed
real_authority_contract.rotation: key/authority rotation policy referenced externally; rotation does not re-mint historic proofs
real_authority_contract.compromise_response: on compromise, revoke via the external revocation source; verify_proof -> RIP-REVOKED-AT-USE; run halts

build_producer_contract.registration: governed ProducerRegistry under a trusted ActivatedRegistryHandle (F2-R1)

oci_producer_contract.execution_identity_keyed_on: executable_digest + authority_reference + runner_identity (distinct from build producer)

properties: resolve_and_verify enforces digest match at expected version

L_F2R3_NEARCOPY.limitation: L-F2R3-NEARCOPY — an OCI record can be a dressed-up copy of build metadata (CR-NEAR-COPY-FROM-BUILD).
L_F2R3_NEARCOPY.rule: OCI evidence is REJECTED unless ALL mandatory independently-inspected values are present AND derived from independent OCI inspection — one differing field is NOT sufficient. Enforced by design.hermes_fw08_content_resolution_v1.detect_alias_or_nearcopy (CR-NEAR-COPY-FROM-BUILD / CR-FABRICATED-OCI-DIGEST / CR-OCI-FROM-ACTIVE-IMPORT / CR-EMBEDDED-EVIDENCE / CR-ALIAS-SAME-CONTENT).

L_F2R3_BYPASS_STATIC.limitation: L-F2R3-BYPASS-STATIC — static assurance that readiness/proof authority cannot be reached via the raw legacy comparator or a side route.
L_F2R3_BYPASS_STATIC.legacy_comparator_note: The legacy comparator validate_image_bound_active_import may REMAIN for fixture comparison (byte-identical) but NEVER confers readiness or proof authority. Enforced by design.hermes_fw08_legacy_comparator_containment_v1: comparator_is_readiness_authority()=False, assert_no_readiness_bypass (LC-WRAPPER-DIRECT-COMPARATOR / LC-CLI-BYPASS / LC-DYNAMIC-ROUTE), guard_not_proof (LC-COMPARATOR-NOT-PROOF-AUTHORITY).

L_F2R3_REFLECTIVE.limitation: L-F2R3-REFLECTIVE — the proof seal is a module-owned ephemeral in-process HMAC; a real proof needs an external signing/attestation boundary the application cannot forge.
L_F2R3_REFLECTIVE.external_signing_or_attestation_boundary: signing/attestation performed outside the application trust boundary
L_F2R3_REFLECTIVE.non_exportable_key_or_equivalent: signing key non-exportable (HSM / KMS / equivalent), never held by the application
L_F2R3_REFLECTIVE.verifier_only_application_interface: the application holds a verifier-only interface; it can verify but never sign
L_F2R3_REFLECTIVE.issuer_identity: external issuer identity bound to the authority root
L_F2R3_REFLECTIVE.signing_policy_scope: scoped signing policy (candidate proofs only; no wildcard)
L_F2R3_REFLECTIVE.revocation: external revocation of issuer/key propagates to verify_proof -> RIP-REVOKED-AT-USE
L_F2R3_REFLECTIVE.key_rotation: issuer key rotation policy; historic proofs not re-minted
L_F2R3_REFLECTIVE.compromise_response: on issuer/key compromise, revoke externally and halt; verify_proof fails closed
